Name: Better small bucket screening
Author: chchbixu
Description:
Keg Selector is a Stardew Valley mod that lets you decide exactly which fruits,
vegetables (and other machine inputs) may be placed into your kegs. Instead of
every crop being brewable, you get an in-game checklist to allow or block
specific items — per keg, per location, or globally. It hooks the game's shared
machine rule evaluation, so denied items are blocked for **both manual drops and
Automate**, with zero extra setup

Manifest.Name: Keg Selector
Manifest.Description: Per-keg and per-scene filtering for kegs (and other machines). Press F8 for the keg you're facing, F9 for every keg in the current location. Works with Automate.
Manifest.Author: WorkBuddy
